generic.Defined scope/population: Goal records for employees affected by a reorg, acquisition, or regulatory shift
generic.In-scope period: The active goal cycle in which the material business change occurs
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger code, effective date, and revised weighting populated on the amendment log
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Re-weighted goal set sums to exactly 100% after the amendment
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Goal version history shows the prior and amended versions with timestamps
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Goals lacking manager re-approval after 3 business days logged for HRBP follow-up
generic.Test population: A sample of amended goal records from the current cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any amended goal set does not total 100% or lacks manager re-approval
generic.Exception handling path: HRBP escalates unresolved amendments directly with the employee's manager
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Amendment recorded with trigger code, 100% weighting, and manager re-approval
generic.Evidence location: Goal amendment log and goal version history in the HRIS

steps.title: Open the affected employee's Goals tab in the HRIS and locate the goal to amend
sop: Navigate to the employee's profile in the HRIS and open the Goals tab.
Locate the specific goal record affected by the reorg, acquisition, or regulatory shift.
Confirm the goal is in an editable, amendable state before proceeding.
Done when the target goal record is open and ready for amendment.
verify: Check the goal record status field for Active or Amendable.
Pass when the correct goal record is open in the HRIS.

steps.title: Record the amendment trigger code and effective date on the goal amendment log
sop: Select the amendment trigger code (reorg, acquisition, regulatory shift) from the dropdown.
Enter the effective date the amendment takes effect.
Add a short justification note referencing the business change.
Done when the trigger code and effective date are saved to the amendment log.
verify: Reopen the amendment log entry and confirm the trigger code and date match the source event.
Pass when the logged trigger code and date are accurate.

steps.title: Re-weight the remaining goals in the HRIS so the total sums to 100%
sop: Open the employee's full goal set showing current weighting percentages.
Adjust each remaining goal's weight to reflect the revised priorities.
Recalculate the total to confirm it equals 100%.
Done when the goal set's weighting total displays exactly 100%.
verify: Sum the displayed weighting column across all active goals.
Pass when the total equals 100% with no rounding gap.

steps.title: Route the amended goal to the employee's manager for re-approval
sop: Click Submit for Approval on the amended goal record.
Confirm the routing shows the employee's current manager as approver.
Notify the manager that a re-approval is pending their action.
Done when the amended goal shows status Pending Manager Approval.
verify: Check the workflow history for the routed approval step.
Pass when the amended goal is queued to the correct manager.

steps.title: Confirm the manager's re-approval is recorded on the goal record
sop: Open the goal record after the manager acts on the approval task.
Confirm the approval decision, approver name, and date are captured.
Follow up with the manager if the approval is still outstanding past 3 business days.
Done when the goal record shows a recorded manager re-approval.
verify: Check the approval field for approver identity and timestamp.
Pass when manager re-approval is recorded with a date.

steps.title: Confirm the goal's version history shows the prior and amended versions
sop: Open the goal record's version history panel in the HRIS.
Confirm the prior version and the amended version both appear with timestamps.
Confirm the amendment trigger code is visible in the version comparison.
Done when both versions are visible with timestamps and the trigger code.
verify: Compare the version history entries against the amendment log.
Pass when both versions and the trigger code are present in history.

steps.title: Close the amendment case and notify the employee of the update
sop: Mark the amendment case as complete in the goal amendment log.
Attach a closing note summarizing the reweighting outcome.
Notify the employee that their goal set has been updated.
Done when the amendment case status shows Closed.
verify: Reopen the case record and confirm the status field reads Closed.
Pass when the case is closed with the closing note attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Manager-submitted individual goal sets awaiting HRBP approval
generic.In-scope period: The current goal-setting submission window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each goal has a specific measurable target, a due date, and a weighting
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Goal weightings sum to 100% across the employee's goal set
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval record shows HRBP name, decision, and timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Goal sets returned for missing SMART criteria logged with review comments
generic.Test population: A sample of goal sets approved during the window
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any approved goal lacks a measurable target or the set does not sum to 100%
generic.Exception handling path: Return the goal set to the manager with specific review comments for correction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approved goal set meets SMART criteria and sums to 100% weighting
generic.Evidence location: Goals Approval queue history in the HRIS

steps.title: Open the manager's submitted goal set in the HRIS Goals Approval queue
sop: Filter the Goals Approval queue to sets awaiting HRBP review.
Open the first submitted goal set and confirm the employee and manager identity.
Confirm the goal set is complete with all expected goal records present.
Done when the goal set is open and ready for SMART-criteria review.
verify: Check the queue status column shows Awaiting HRBP Review.
Pass when the correct goal set is open for review.

steps.title: Verify each goal statement includes a specific, measurable target and due date
sop: Read each goal statement in the submitted set.
Confirm each goal names a measurable target and a due date.
Note any goal that is vague or lacks a due date.
Done when every goal has been checked against the measurable-target and due-date criteria.
verify: Recheck flagged goals against the SMART checklist.
Pass when every goal shows a measurable target and due date.

steps.title: Verify each goal's weighting reflects role priority and sums to 100%
sop: Review the weighting assigned to each goal against the employee's role priorities.
Add the weighting percentages across the full goal set.
Flag the set if the total does not equal 100%.
Done when the weighting total is confirmed as 100% or flagged for correction.
verify: Recalculate the weighting total independently.
Pass when the total equals 100%.

steps.title: Return goals lacking measurable targets to the manager with review comments
sop: Click Return to Manager on any goal failing the SMART-criteria check.
Enter specific review comments identifying the missing measurable target or due date.
Confirm the returned goal set shows status Returned for Revision.
Done when all failing goals are returned with comments explaining the required fix.
verify: Reopen the returned goal set and confirm review comments are attached.
Pass when every returned goal has a specific comment explaining the deficiency.

steps.title: Click Approve on the goal set once SMART criteria and weighting are satisfied
sop: Confirm all goals in the set pass the SMART-criteria and weighting checks.
Click Approve on the goal set in the Goals Approval queue.
Confirm the system records the HRBP approver identity and date.
Done when the goal set status changes to Approved.
verify: Reopen the goal set and confirm the status shows Approved.
Pass when the approver name and approval date are recorded.

steps.title: Confirm the approved goal set is ready for publication
sop: Open the approved goal set to confirm no fields changed after approval.
Confirm the approval record includes SMART-criteria review comments where applicable.
Flag the set as ready for the goal-publishing step.
Done when the approved set is confirmed unchanged and ready to publish.
verify: Compare the approved set against the version reviewed by the HRBP.
Pass when no unapproved changes are present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Final year-end goal achievement records for the closed performance cycle
generic.In-scope period: The closed year-end performance cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each record shows final completion percentage and manager comments
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exported record count matches the closed cycle's active employee population
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Export tagged with performance year and cycle identifier before archiving
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Employees missing a final completion percentage logged for HRBP follow-up
generic.Test population: The full year-end goal achievement export for the closed cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the archived export is missing employees or lacks completion percentages
generic.Exception handling path: Route missing records back to the HRBP for completion before re-archiving
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete export archived, tagged, and flagged as calibration input
generic.Evidence location: Goal-setting SharePoint library, tagged by performance year

steps.title: Export the year-end goal achievement report from the HRIS for the closed cycle
sop: Open the Goal Achievement report in the HRIS and filter to the closed cycle.
Run the export covering all active employees in the cycle.
Save the export file locally before archiving.
Done when the export file is generated for the closed cycle population.
verify: Open the export file and spot-check a sample of employee rows.
Pass when the export contains rows for the full closed-cycle population.

steps.title: Confirm each employee record shows completion percentage and manager comments
sop: Scan the export for blank completion-percentage or comment fields.
Cross-check any blank rows against the source HRIS goal record.
Correct or flag rows missing required data.
Done when every row shows a completion percentage and manager comments.
verify: Filter the export for blank required fields.
Pass when no rows remain with a blank completion percentage or comment.

steps.title: Tag the export with performance year and cycle identifier
sop: Rename or label the export file with the performance year and cycle code.
Add the cycle identifier as metadata on the file before upload.
Confirm the naming convention matches prior-year archived exports.
Done when the export file is tagged with the year and cycle identifier.
verify: Check the file name and metadata against the naming convention.
Pass when the tag matches the closed cycle exactly.

steps.title: Archive the tagged export to the goal-setting SharePoint library
sop: Open the goal-setting SharePoint library.
Upload the tagged export to the correct performance-year folder.
Confirm the file uploads without error and appears in the folder listing.
Done when the export is archived in the SharePoint library.
verify: Open the SharePoint folder and confirm the file is present.
Pass when the archived file matches the exported file's content.

steps.title: Flag the archived file as an input to the upcoming calibration cycle
sop: Open the archived file's properties in SharePoint.
Set the Calibration Input flag to Yes for the upcoming cycle.
Add a note referencing the calibration session it feeds.
Done when the file is flagged as a calibration input.
verify: Reopen the file properties and confirm the flag is set.
Pass when the Calibration Input flag reads Yes.

steps.title: Verify the archive folder permissions restrict access to HRBP and People Analytics
sop: Open the SharePoint folder's permission settings.
Confirm only HRBP and People Analytics roles have access.
Remove any unauthorized group or individual access found.
Done when folder permissions are confirmed restricted to the correct roles.
verify: Review the permission list for the folder.
Pass when only HRBP and People Analytics roles are listed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Company, division, and department OKR records for the cascade cycle
generic.In-scope period: The period before goal-setting opens for the annual cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each division and department OKR has an accountable owner populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every division OKR links to a company OKR and every department OKR links to a division OKR
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: OKR library shows the published cascade tree with creation timestamps
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Departments without an accountable owner logged for HRBP follow-up
generic.Test population: The full published OKR tree for the cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any division or department OKR is missing an owner or parent link
generic.Exception handling path: Route unowned or unlinked OKRs back to the accountable leader for correction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete parent-child OKR cascade published before goal-setting opens
generic.Evidence location: OKR library in the HRIS

steps.title: Load the approved company-level OKRs into the HRIS OKR library
sop: Open the OKR library module in the HRIS.
Create a new OKR record for each approved company-level objective.
Populate the key results and target metrics for each objective.
Done when all approved company-level OKRs are loaded into the library.
verify: Compare the loaded OKRs against the approved company OKR document.
Pass when every approved objective appears in the library.

steps.title: Create division-level OKR records linked as children of the company OKR
sop: Open each division and create its OKR record in the library.
Set the parent-link field to the relevant company OKR.
Confirm the division OKR's key results support the company objective.
Done when every division has an OKR record linked to a company OKR.
verify: Open the parent-link field on each division OKR.
Pass when every division OKR references a valid company OKR.

steps.title: Create department-level OKR records linked as children of the division OKR
sop: Open each department and create its OKR record in the library.
Set the parent-link field to the relevant division OKR.
Confirm the department OKR's key results support the division objective.
Done when every department has an OKR record linked to a division OKR.
verify: Open the parent-link field on each department OKR.
Pass when every department OKR references a valid division OKR.

steps.title: Confirm each department OKR owner field is populated with the accountable leader
sop: Open each department OKR record and check the owner field.
Populate the owner field with the accountable department leader's name.
Flag any department OKR still missing an owner.
Done when every department OKR has an accountable owner populated.
verify: Filter the OKR library for records with a blank owner field.
Pass when no department OKR remains without an owner.

steps.title: Publish the cascaded OKR tree so managers can link individual goals to it
sop: Review the full company-division-department tree for completeness.
Click Publish on the OKR tree in the library.
Confirm the published tree is visible in the goal-linking menu.
Done when the cascaded OKR tree is published and selectable by managers.
verify: Open the goal-setting screen and confirm the OKR tree appears in the link menu.
Pass when managers can select any level of the published tree.

steps.title: Confirm the complete cascade is in place before the goal-setting window opens
sop: Run a completeness check across the company, division, and department OKR levels.
Confirm no orphaned OKR lacks a parent link at any level.
Confirm the goal-setting window has not yet opened.
Done when the complete cascade is verified ahead of the window opening.
verify: Re-run the completeness check and review the output for gaps.
Pass when zero orphaned OKRs remain across all three levels.

generic.Defined scope/population: Managers with direct reports missing a submitted goal set past the deadline
generic.In-scope period: The current cycle's goal submission deadline and follow-up window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Goal Submission Status report filtered correctly to Not Submitted
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of outstanding employees before and after the follow-up window is tracked
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Follow-up date logged against each outstanding employee record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Managers who do not respond to the reminder logged for HRBP escalation
generic.Test population: The Not Submitted list at the close of the follow-up window
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any employee remains Not Submitted after the follow-up window closes
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate non-responsive managers to their HRBP for direct intervention
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No employees remain in Not Submitted status after the follow-up window closes
generic.Evidence location: Goal Submission Status report and follow-up tracker in the HRIS

steps.title: Run the Goal Submission Status report filtered to Not Submitted
sop: Open the Goal Submission Status report in the HRIS.
Filter the report to the current cycle and status Not Submitted.
Export the filtered list of employees and their managers.
Done when the current Not Submitted list is generated for the cycle.
verify: Spot-check a sample employee's goal status directly in their profile.
Pass when the filtered list matches actual Not Submitted employees.

steps.title: Identify managers with direct reports missing a goal set past the deadline
sop: Group the Not Submitted list by manager.
Confirm the deadline date has passed for each grouped employee.
Build the manager contact list from the grouped output.
Done when the manager list with outstanding direct reports is compiled.
verify: Cross-check the manager list against the org chart for accuracy.
Pass when every manager on the list has at least one outstanding direct report.

steps.title: Send the standard follow-up reminder email to each outstanding manager
sop: Open the standard goal-submission reminder email template.
Attach the manager's team roster of outstanding employees.
Send the reminder to each manager on the outstanding list.
Done when reminder emails are sent to every outstanding manager.
verify: Check the sent-mail log for delivery to each manager.
Pass when every outstanding manager received the reminder email.

steps.title: Log the follow-up date against each outstanding employee record in the tracker
sop: Open the goal-follow-up tracker.
Enter the reminder send date against each outstanding employee row.
Confirm the manager name is recorded alongside the employee row.
Done when every outstanding employee has a logged follow-up date.
verify: Spot-check tracker rows against the sent-mail log.
Pass when every outstanding row has a matching logged date.

steps.title: Re-run the status report after the reminder window closes
sop: Reopen the Goal Submission Status report after the reminder window closes.
Filter again to status Not Submitted.
Compare the new count against the pre-reminder count.
Done when the reduced or zero outstanding count is confirmed.
verify: Compare the before and after Not Submitted counts.
Pass when the outstanding count has decreased or reached zero.

steps.title: Escalate any employees still outstanding to the HRBP for direct intervention
sop: Identify employees still shown as Not Submitted after the window closes.
Escalate each remaining case directly with the manager or their leader.
Log the escalation outcome on the tracker.
Done when every remaining outstanding case has a logged escalation outcome.
verify: Reopen the tracker and confirm each escalated case has an outcome.
Pass when no outstanding case lacks an escalation outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Active employee goals due for the mid-year check-in
generic.In-scope period: The mid-year check-in window of the current goal cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each active goal has an employee progress update and manager coaching note
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of closed check-in tasks matches the active employee population
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Check-in task shows employee update and manager note with timestamps
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Goals flagged at risk or off track logged for HRBP follow-up
generic.Test population: All active goals in scope for the mid-year check-in
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any active goal lacks an employee update or manager coaching note
generic.Exception handling path: HRBP follows up directly with the manager on at-risk or off-track goals
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Employee progress update and manager coaching note present on every active goal
generic.Evidence location: Mid-Year Check-In task history in the HRIS

steps.title: Open the Mid-Year Check-In task in the HRIS for each employee
sop: Filter the Mid-Year Check-In task queue to the current cycle.
Open the check-in task for the first employee in scope.
Confirm the employee's active goal list is displayed on the task.
Done when the check-in task is open and ready for review.
verify: Check the task status column for In Progress or Awaiting Review.
Pass when the correct employee's check-in task is open.

steps.title: Confirm the employee has entered a progress update against each active goal
sop: Review each active goal for an employee-entered progress update.
Confirm the update reflects current status, not a placeholder entry.
Flag any goal missing a progress update.
Done when every active goal shows an employee progress update.
verify: Filter the goal list for blank progress-update fields.
Pass when no active goal is missing a progress update.

steps.title: Confirm the manager has added a coaching note responding to the update
sop: Review each goal for a manager coaching note.
Confirm the note responds to the employee's specific progress update.
Flag any goal missing a coaching note.
Done when every active goal shows a manager coaching note.
verify: Filter the goal list for blank coaching-note fields.
Pass when no active goal is missing a coaching note.

steps.title: Flag any goal marked at risk or off track for HRBP follow-up
sop: Review goal status indicators for At Risk or Off Track flags.
Open each flagged goal and confirm the manager's note addresses the risk.
Add the flagged goal to the HRBP follow-up list.
Done when all at-risk or off-track goals are on the follow-up list.
verify: Cross-check the follow-up list against the goal status filter.
Pass when every at-risk or off-track goal appears on the list.

steps.title: Close the check-in task once employee update and manager note are both present
sop: Confirm both required fields are complete on the check-in task.
Click Close on the Mid-Year Check-In task.
Confirm the task status updates to Complete.
Done when the check-in task is closed for the employee.
verify: Reopen the task and confirm the status reads Complete.
Pass when the task is closed with both required fields present.

steps.title: Confirm all employee check-ins are closed before the window ends
sop: Run the check-in completion report for the full population.
Identify any employee whose check-in task remains open.
Follow up directly with any remaining open cases before the window closes.
Done when the completion report shows all check-ins closed.
verify: Review the completion report's open-task count.
Pass when the open-task count reaches zero before the window closes.

generic.Defined scope/population: The annual goal-setting cycle configuration in Workday HCM
generic.In-scope period: The upcoming annual goal cycle before it opens to employees
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission open/close dates, approval routing, and rating scale are configured
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Test goal submission completes through the full configured workflow
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Performance Cycle Setup screen shows the saved configuration with timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any test submission failure logged with the corrective configuration change
generic.Test population: One test goal submission run through the configured workflow
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the test submission does not reach the expected approval and rating steps
generic.Exception handling path: Reconfigure the failing routing or scale setting and rerun the test submission
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Cycle dates, approval routing, and rating scale configured and validated by test
generic.Evidence location: Performance Cycle Setup screen in Workday HCM

steps.title: Open the Performance Cycle Setup screen in Workday HCM
sop: Navigate to the Performance Cycle Setup screen in Workday HCM.
Create a new cycle record for the upcoming annual goal-setting period.
Confirm the cycle name follows the standard naming convention.
Done when a new cycle record is created and ready for configuration.
verify: Reopen the cycle list and confirm the new record appears.
Pass when the cycle record exists with the correct name.

steps.title: Enter the goal submission open and close dates for the annual cycle
sop: Enter the submission window open date on the cycle record.
Enter the submission window close date on the cycle record.
Confirm the dates align with the communicated timeline.
Done when both open and close dates are saved on the cycle record.
verify: Reopen the cycle record and confirm the saved dates.
Pass when the dates match the communicated timeline exactly.

steps.title: Configure the approval routing for goal records in Workday HCM
sop: Open the approval routing configuration for the cycle.
Set the routing sequence to employee, then manager, then HRBP.
Save the routing configuration to the cycle record.
Done when the approval routing sequence is saved and active.
verify: Trace the configured routing sequence in the setup screen.
Pass when the sequence reads employee, manager, HRBP in order.

steps.title: Set the rating scale and weighting rules to match the approved template
sop: Open the rating scale configuration for the cycle.
Select the approved rating scale and weighting rule set.
Confirm the scale matches the template signed off by HR leadership.
Done when the rating scale and weighting rules are saved on the cycle.
verify: Compare the configured scale against the approved template document.
Pass when the configuration matches the template exactly.

steps.title: Run a test goal submission through the configured workflow
sop: Create a test employee goal submission using the new cycle configuration.
Submit the test goal through employee, manager, and HRBP approval steps.
Confirm the test submission reaches Approved status.
Done when the test submission completes the full configured workflow.
verify: Review the test submission's workflow history for each step.
Pass when the test reaches Approved without configuration errors.

steps.title: Activate the cycle for the full employee population
sop: Delete or archive the test submission record.
Click Activate on the cycle record in the setup screen.
Confirm the cycle status changes to Active and open for submission.
Done when the cycle is activated and open to all employees.
verify: Check the cycle status field in the setup screen.
Pass when the status reads Active before the communicated open date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Published individual goals for the current cycle
generic.In-scope period: The current goal cycle after the publish step
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each published goal has a populated OKR reference field
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: 100% of published goals show a valid divisional or company OKR link
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Goal-to-OKR Linkage report timestamped for the current cycle run
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unlinked goals returned to the manager are logged until relinked
generic.Test population: The full Goal-to-OKR Linkage report for the current cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any published goal remains without a linked OKR after resubmission
generic.Exception handling path: Return the unlinked goal to the manager with the divisional OKR menu
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No published goal remains without a linked divisional or company OKR
generic.Evidence location: Goal-to-OKR Linkage report in the HRIS

steps.title: Run the Goal-to-OKR Linkage report for the current cycle
sop: Open the Goal-to-OKR Linkage report in the HRIS.
Run the report against the current cycle's published goals.
Export the report results for review.
Done when the linkage report is generated for the current cycle.
verify: Spot-check a sample goal's OKR link against the report.
Pass when the report accurately reflects current linkage status.

steps.title: Filter the report to goals with no OKR reference populated
sop: Apply the filter for a blank OKR-reference field.
Confirm the filtered list shows only unlinked goals.
Group the unlinked goals by manager.
Done when the unlinked-goal list is filtered and grouped by manager.
verify: Recheck a filtered row's OKR field directly in the HRIS.
Pass when every filtered row genuinely has no OKR link.

steps.title: Return each unlinked goal to the manager with the divisional OKR menu
sop: Open each unlinked goal record.
Click Return to Manager and attach the divisional OKR selection menu.
Add a comment requesting the manager select the applicable OKR.
Done when every unlinked goal is returned with the OKR selection menu attached.
verify: Confirm the returned goal shows status Returned for Revision.
Pass when every unlinked goal has been returned to its manager.

steps.title: Confirm the corrected goal shows a valid OKR link after resubmission
sop: Reopen each returned goal after the manager resubmits it.
Confirm the OKR-reference field now shows a valid link.
Confirm the linked OKR is at the correct division or company level.
Done when every resubmitted goal shows a valid OKR link.
verify: Click through the OKR link to confirm it resolves to a real OKR record.
Pass when the link resolves correctly for every resubmitted goal.

steps.title: Re-run the linkage report to confirm 100% of published goals are linked
sop: Rerun the Goal-to-OKR Linkage report for the current cycle.
Confirm the unlinked-goal count reads zero.
Archive the final report as evidence of full linkage.
Done when the rerun report shows 100% of published goals linked.
verify: Review the rerun report's unlinked-goal count.
Pass when the count reads zero across the full published population.

steps.title: Publish the final linkage confirmation to the OKR library
sop: Attach the final linkage report to the cycle's OKR library record.
Note the confirmation date on the cycle record.
Notify the People Analytics team the linkage check is complete.
Done when the confirmation is attached and the team is notified.
verify: Open the cycle record and confirm the report attachment is present.
Pass when the confirmation date and attachment are both present.

generic.Defined scope/population: All managers and employees participating in the annual goal-setting window
generic.In-scope period: The annual goal-setting submission window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each submitted goal has a measurable target and a due date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Submitted goal-set count matches the active employee population before close

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Drafts failing the SMART check logged with coaching comments until corrected
generic.Test population: The full goal draft queue during the setting window

generic.Exception handling path: Coach the manager directly via the review comment field until the draft passes
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All employees have a submitted goal set meeting SMART criteria before the window closes
generic.Evidence location: Goal draft queue and SMART guide distribution log in the HRIS

steps.title: Distribute the SMART goal-setting guide and template to all managers
sop: Open the standard SMART goal-setting guide and template.
Send the guide and template to the full manager distribution list.
Confirm the send log shows delivery to all active managers.
Done when every manager has received the guide and template.
verify: Review the send log for delivery confirmation.
Pass when the guide reached 100% of active managers.

steps.title: Confirm each manager has scheduled a goal-setting conversation with each direct report
sop: Send the scheduling confirmation request to all managers.
Track which managers confirm a scheduled conversation per direct report.
Follow up with managers who have not confirmed scheduling.
Done when every manager confirms a scheduled conversation with each direct report.
verify: Review the scheduling tracker for completeness by manager.
Pass when every direct report has a confirmed scheduled conversation.

steps.title: Monitor the goal draft queue for entries missing a measurable target or due date
sop: Open the goal draft queue in the HRIS during the setting window.
Filter for drafts missing a measurable target or due date.
Note each incomplete draft for manager coaching.
Done when the incomplete-draft list is current for the review cycle.
verify: Recheck a sample flagged draft directly in the HRIS.
Pass when the flagged list accurately reflects incomplete drafts.

steps.title: Coach managers whose drafts fail the SMART quality check via review comments
sop: Open each flagged draft and add a specific SMART-quality review comment.
Explain the missing element (measurable target, due date, or weighting).
Notify the manager that coaching comments are waiting on the draft.
Done when every flagged draft has a coaching comment attached.
verify: Reopen each flagged draft and confirm a comment is present.
Pass when every flagged draft has an actionable coaching comment.

steps.title: Confirm all employees have a submitted goal set before the window closes
sop: Run the submission completion report for the full population.
Identify any employee still missing a submitted goal set.
Escalate remaining gaps to the manager before the window closes.
Done when the completion report shows full submission coverage.
verify: Review the completion report's outstanding count.
Pass when the outstanding count reaches zero before the window closes.

steps.title: Confirm the final submitted population meets SMART criteria
sop: Sample a cross-section of submitted goal sets across departments.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported activity volume matches the source HRBP case tracking system
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Delivered report logged with the delivery date and version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Discrepancies found in the accuracy review corrected before delivery
generic.Test population: A sample portfolio's metrics checked against source dashboards
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the report is delivered after the monthly reporting deadline
generic.Exception handling path: HR Business Partner escalates a delivery delay to HR leadership
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Monthly people metrics and HRBP activity report delivered to CHRO by the reporting deadline
generic.Evidence location: Power BI monthly CHRO report and delivery log

steps.title: Compile monthly people metrics and HRBP activity volume
sop: Pull turnover, engagement, and open case metrics for the closed month.
Pull HRBP activity volume by portfolio for the closed month.
Consolidate the metrics and activity data into the report data set.
Done when all required metrics and activity data are compiled.
verify: Spot-check one portfolio's compiled activity volume against the source tracker.
Pass when the compiled figure matches the source tracker.

steps.title: Format the summary into the CHRO monthly report template
sop: Open the CHRO monthly report template.
Populate the template with the compiled metrics and activity data.
Confirm the formatting matches the standard template layout.
Done when the summary is formatted into the report template.
verify: Reread the formatted report against the template's required sections.
Pass when all required sections are populated correctly.

steps.title: Review the draft summary for accuracy against source dashboards
sop: Compare each figure in the draft report against the source Power BI dashboards.
Correct any discrepancy found during the review.
Confirm the draft is accurate before finalizing.
Done when the draft report is confirmed accurate against source dashboards.
verify: Recheck one corrected figure against the source dashboard.
Pass when the corrected figure matches the source dashboard.

steps.title: Deliver the report to the CHRO by the reporting deadline
sop: Finalize the report for delivery.
Send the report to the CHRO ahead of the monthly reporting deadline.
Confirm the send timestamp is before the deadline.
Done when the report is delivered before the reporting deadline.
verify: Check the send timestamp against the monthly reporting deadline.
Pass when the report was delivered on or before the deadline.

steps.title: Log the delivery date and confirm receipt
sop: Log the delivery date against the monthly report record.
Follow up with the CHRO's office to confirm receipt.
Record the confirmed receipt on the report log.
Done when receipt is confirmed and logged against the report.
verify: Recheck the report log for the confirmed receipt entry.
Pass when receipt confirmation is logged for the delivered report.

steps.title: Escalate any delivery delay to HR leadership
sop: Identify if the delivery deadline was missed for the reporting month.
Escalate the missed deadline and reason to HR leadership.
Document the corrective step taken to prevent recurrence.
Done when any missed deadline is escalated and documented.
verify: Recheck the escalation log for the documented corrective step.
Pass when a missed deadline shows a documented escalation and correction.

generic.Defined scope/population: HRBP case volume and consultation requests across all business units for the review period
generic.In-scope period: The current HRBP service demand review period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Case volume and consultation counts populated by business unit and HRBP
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total case volume reviewed matches the source case tracking system
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Demand review findings documented with the review period date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Business units trending under- or over-served flagged for rebalancing consideration
generic.Test population: A sample business unit's demand figures checked against Workday HCM
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a flagged business unit lacks supporting case volume data
generic.Exception handling path: People Analytics corrects the demand figures before routing findings
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Demand reviewed by business unit with under- or over-served units identified for rebalancing
generic.Evidence location: Workday HCM HRBP demand review findings document

steps.title: Pull HRBP case volume and consultation request counts
sop: Open the Workday HCM case tracking data for the review period.
Pull case volume and consultation request counts by business unit.
Confirm the data covers the full review period.
Done when case volume and consultation counts are pulled by business unit.
verify: Spot-check one business unit's pulled count against the source case tracker.
Pass when the pulled count matches the source tracker.

steps.title: Compare demand levels against each HRBP's portfolio size
sop: Pull each HRBP's current portfolio size from the coverage assignment records.
Compare the pulled demand levels against each HRBP's portfolio size.
Note the ratio of demand to portfolio size for each HRBP.
Done when demand is compared against portfolio size for every HRBP.
verify: Recheck one HRBP's demand-to-portfolio ratio calculation.
Pass when the recalculated ratio matches the compared value.

steps.title: Identify business units trending toward under- or over-served status
sop: Review the demand-to-portfolio comparison for each business unit.
Flag business units trending toward under- or over-served status.
Note the trend direction and magnitude for each flagged unit.
Done when trending business units are identified and flagged.
verify: Recheck one flagged business unit's trend against its underlying data.
Pass when the flagged trend direction matches the underlying data.

steps.title: Document the demand review findings
sop: Compile the demand comparison and flagged trends into a findings document.
Include supporting data references for each flagged business unit.
Confirm the findings document is complete for the review period.
Done when the demand review findings document is complete.
verify: Reread the findings document against the flagged business units.
Pass when the findings document accurately reflects the flagged units.

steps.title: Route the findings to HR leadership for coverage model approval
sop: Send the completed findings document to HR leadership.
Request approval for the coverage rebalancing decision.
Confirm HR leadership acknowledges receipt of the findings.
Done when the findings are routed and acknowledgment is confirmed.
verify: Check the routing log for HR leadership's acknowledgment.
Pass when acknowledgment is logged for the routed findings.

steps.title: Confirm the findings are handed off to the rebalancing process
sop: Confirm the approved findings are passed to the coverage rebalancing task.
Verify the rebalancing task references the demand review findings.
Close the demand review record once handoff is confirmed.
Done when the demand review record is closed with a confirmed handoff.
verify: Recheck the rebalancing task for the referenced demand review findings.
Pass when the rebalancing task correctly references the findings.

generic.Defined scope/population: Complex employee relations situations routed to HRBP for manager coaching support
generic.In-scope period: The active ER case from opening through manager acknowledgment
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coaching guidance and manager questions populated on the ER case record
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of acknowledged coaching sessions matches the number of opened ER cases
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: ER case record dated with the coaching session and acknowledgment
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases requiring escalation logged with the escalation path taken
generic.Test population: A sample of ER cases with recorded coaching guidance
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the manager proceeds with action before acknowledging guidance
generic.Exception handling path: Employee Relations Manager escalates an unacknowledged case to HR leadership
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coaching guidance documented and acknowledged by the manager before independent action is taken
generic.Evidence location: HRIS ER case record coaching and acknowledgment fields

steps.title: Open the ER case record for the complex situation
sop: Open a new ER case record for the reported employee relations situation.
Record the situation summary and the manager involved.
Confirm the case is categorized correctly by situation type.
Done when the ER case record is open with the situation documented.
verify: Reopen the case record and confirm the situation summary is accurate.
Pass when the case record accurately reflects the reported situation.

steps.title: Coach the manager on documentation standards
sop: Discuss the appropriate documentation standards for the situation with the manager.
Provide examples of compliant documentation for similar situations.
Answer the manager's questions about the documentation expectations.
Done when the manager is coached on documentation standards.
verify: Recheck the manager's subsequent documentation against the coached standard.
Pass when the manager's documentation follows the coached standard.

steps.title: Advise on the correct escalation path if required
sop: Assess whether the situation requires ER or employment counsel involvement.
Advise the manager on the correct escalation path if involvement is required.
Confirm the manager understands when and how to escalate.
Done when escalation guidance is provided if the situation requires it.
verify: Recheck the case for whether escalation guidance matches the situation's severity.
Pass when the escalation guidance provided matches the required path.

steps.title: Record the coaching guidance and manager questions
sop: Record the coaching guidance provided on the ER case record.
Record the manager's questions raised during the coaching conversation.
Confirm the record is saved with a timestamp.
Done when guidance and questions are recorded on the ER case record.
verify: Reopen the case record and confirm the guidance and questions are saved.
Pass when the saved record matches the coaching conversation.

steps.title: Confirm the manager acknowledges the guidance
sop: Request the manager's acknowledgment of the coaching guidance provided.
Confirm the acknowledgment is captured on the ER case record.
Verify the acknowledgment occurs before the manager takes independent action.
Done when the manager's acknowledgment is captured before action.
verify: Check the timestamp of the acknowledgment against any subsequent manager action.
Pass when the acknowledgment precedes any independent action taken.

steps.title: Close the coaching support and confirm no escalation is outstanding
sop: Confirm any required escalation was completed or is in progress.
Close the coaching support entry on the ER case record.
Note the final outcome of the coaching support provided.
Done when the coaching support entry is closed with outcome noted.
verify: Recheck the case record for the closed coaching support entry.
Pass when the entry is closed with the outcome documented.

generic.Defined scope/population: Business unit leaders and managers served by HRBPs for the semi-annual survey
generic.In-scope period: The current semi-annual HRBP satisfaction survey cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Satisfaction score computed and populated per HRBP and in aggregate
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Survey response count meets the minimum threshold for statistical validity
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published scores dated with the current survey cycle period
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Below-threshold response rates logged with an extended collection window
generic.Test population: A sample of HRBP satisfaction scores across the served population
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the response rate falls below the minimum statistical validity threshold
generic.Exception handling path: People Analytics extends the collection window for a below-threshold response rate
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Satisfaction scores computed per HRBP and tracked against the prior period
generic.Evidence location: HRIS HR Business Partnering performance dashboard

steps.title: Deploy the semi-annual HRBP satisfaction survey
sop: Load the semi-annual HRBP satisfaction survey instrument in the HRIS.
Confirm the distribution list includes business unit leaders and managers served.
Launch the survey to the confirmed distribution list.
Done when the survey is launched to the full served population.
verify: Check the HRIS for the survey's active status and distribution count.
Pass when the survey is active with the full served population included.

steps.title: Confirm the response rate meets the minimum validity threshold
sop: Monitor the survey response rate through the collection window.
Compare the response rate against the minimum statistical validity threshold.
Extend the collection window if the threshold is not met.
Done when the response rate meets or exceeds the validity threshold.
verify: Recheck the final response rate against the validity threshold.
Pass when the response rate meets or exceeds the threshold.

steps.title: Compute the satisfaction score per HRBP and in aggregate
sop: Aggregate survey responses by individual HRBP.
Compute each HRBP's satisfaction score using the approved methodology.
Compute the aggregate satisfaction score across all HRBPs.
Done when per-HRBP and aggregate scores are computed.
verify: Recalculate one HRBP's score manually from the underlying responses.
Pass when the recalculated score matches the computed score.

steps.title: Compare the current period score against the prior period
sop: Pull the prior period's satisfaction scores for comparison.
Compare the current period score against the prior period per HRBP.
Note any HRBP with a material change in trend.
Done when the current period is compared against the prior period.
verify: Recheck the trend comparison for one HRBP against both period scores.
Pass when the trend comparison accurately reflects both periods' scores.

steps.title: Publish the scores to the HR Business Partnering performance dashboard
sop: Push the computed scores and trend comparison to the performance dashboard.
Confirm the dashboard displays per-HRBP and aggregate scores.
Set the dashboard's publish date to the current cycle.
Done when the scores are published on the performance dashboard.
verify: Open the published dashboard and confirm the scores and dates are current.
Pass when the dashboard reflects the current cycle's scores.

steps.title: Log any HRBP with a material unfavorable trend for follow-up
sop: Review the trend comparison for any HRBP scoring materially lower.
Log the flagged HRBP for follow-up discussion.
Notify HR leadership of the flagged trend.
Done when material unfavorable trends are logged and HR leadership notified.
verify: Recheck the log for the flagged HRBP and leadership notification.
Pass when every material unfavorable trend is logged with notification.
